canonical_project: Magnora Data Center / Blix AI data center (former Bankenes Betalingssentral premises)
owner: Magnora Data Center / Blix Group JV
notes: Aug 2026: Magnora Data Center and Blix Group (owner of Blix Solutions) formed a 50/50 JV to develop a new AI data center in the Oslo area, buying a business section in the former Bankenes Betalingssentral (Norwegian banks' payment clearing) building. Capacity not disclosed.
